## Review checklist

- [ ] No real token, PII, private message, absolute personal path, or unredacted artifact is included.
- [ ] New behavior has negative and boundary cases with a fixed seed/clock where relevant.
- [ ] Public documentation, compatibility matrix, and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] UI changes include accessible labels and screenshots that use only project-owned assets/synthetic data.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for unrelated changes and generated noise.
